māzŏnŏmus , i, m. (acc. to others, māzŏnŏmon , i, n.; the m. form corresponds with the Greek word μαζονομος, sc. κύκλος),
I.a dish, charger, Varr. R. R. 3, 4, 3: “deinde secuti Mazonomo pueri magno discerpta ferentes Membra gruis, etc.,” Hor. S. 2, 8, 86 (cf. Schol. Aug. ad loc.); Nemes. de Aucup. 16.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
